mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calc_task (task_type, business_scope, request_key, status, priority, worker_id, lease_until, heartbeat_at, progress_current, progress_total, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_run_at, input_payload, input_checksum, result_resource_id, error_code, error_message, phase, success_roots, failed_roots, created_by) VALUES (#{taskType}, #{businessScope}, #{requestKey}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{workerId}, #{leaseUntil}, #{heartbeatAt}, #{progressCurrent}, #{progressTotal}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRunAt}, #{inputPayload}, #{inputChecksum}, #{resultResourceId}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{phase}, #{successRoots}, #{failedRoots}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, status, progress_current, progress_total, phase, error_message FROM calc_task WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM calc_task WHERE (task_type='MRP_CALCULATION' AND request_key LIKE CONCAT('mrp-calc-', #{batchId}, '-%')) OR (task_type='MRP_MATERIAL_ANALYSIS' AND request_key LIKE CONCAT('mrp-material-', #{batchId}, '-%')) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 )

SELECT id, task_type, status, progress_current, progress_total, phase, result_resource_id, error_message, created_at, finished_at FROM calc_task WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM calc_task WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND request_key LIKE CONCAT(#{requestPrefix}, #{batchId}, '-%') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 )
SELECT * FROM calc_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND task_type IN ('MRP_PUBLISH', 'MRP_REVISION') ORDER BY priority ASC, created_at ASC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE calc_task SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE calc_task SET progress_current = #{progressCurrent}, progress_total = #{progressTotal}, phase = #{phase}, success_roots = #{successRoots}, failed_roots = #{failedRoots}, heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE calc_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = 'CALC_ERROR', error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND worker_id = #{workerId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE calc_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_resource_id = #{resultId}, progress_current = 100, progress_total = 100, phase = 'COMPLETED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND worker_id = #{workerId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE calc_task SET status='FAILED', error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED', error_message=CONCAT('Task lease expired after ', #{timeoutMinutes}, ' minutes'), finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version=version+1 WHERE status='RUNNING' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND attempt_count >= max_attempts AND task_type NOT IN ('MRP_CALCULATION', 'MRP_MATERIAL_ANALYSIS')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM calc_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND task_type IN ('MRP_CALCULATION', 'MRP_MATERIAL_ANALYSIS') ORDER BY lease_until, id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE calc_task SET status = 'PENDING', worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, phase = 'QUEUED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND attempt_count < max_attempts

UPDATE calc_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = 'LEASE_EXPIRED', error_message = 'Task lease expired after maximum attempts', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND attempt_count >= max_attempts
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM calc_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND task_type IN ('MRP_CALCULATION','MRP_MATERIAL_ANALYSIS') ORDER BY priority ASC, created_at ASC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE calc_task SET input_payload = #{inputPayload} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE calc_task SET status = 'RUNNING', worker_id = #{workerId}, started_at = NOW(), heartbeat_at = NOW(), lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseMinutes} MINUTE), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{version}
UPDATE calc_task SET heartbeat_at = NOW(), lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseMinutes} MINUTE) WHERE id = #{id} AND worker_id = #{workerId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE calc_task SET heartbeat_at = NOW(), lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseMinutes} MINUTE) WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM calc_task WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} AND status = #{status}
